entries.title: Show HN: my weekend project, jetsetter
entries.author: paulsingh
entries.current_title: Show HN: my weekend project, jetsetter
entries.excerpt: I've been traveling quite a bit for the last few weeks and thought it might be cool to have my laptop "check in" every few hours. So far, so good. The idea is for jetsetter to generate cool maps and other info about your habits... sort of like Dopplr, but for your laptop. It's still pretty ghetto, but becoming kind of interesting... thought I'd share it and see if you guys find it useful too. For now, you'll need to drop your API key into the sample bash script and then set i
